items.title_zh: 英伟达为 GTX 700-10 系显卡发布 582.78 安全更新，修复 114 个漏洞
items.title_en: Nvidia Releases 582.78 Security Driver for GTX 700–10 Series, Fixing 114 Vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，英伟达于当地时间 30 日推出 GeForce 安全更新驱动程序 582.78，适用于 Maxwell、Pascal 和 Volta 架构显卡，涵盖 GTX 700 系、GTX 900 系、GTX 10 系显卡及 Tesla V100、Titan V 等专业卡。 据IT之家了解，英伟达已经不会为上述显卡发布常规 Game Ready 驱动更新，但仍然会不时推出安全更新。该更新支持 Windows 10 和 Windows 11 操作系统， 大小为 912.74 MB 。 同时， 该更新修复了显示驱动程序和 vGPU 的 114 个漏洞 ，其中大多数漏洞直接影响显卡驱动程序，包括 76 个高危漏洞和 37 个中危漏洞。 此外，此次驱动更新适用于 GeForce GTX 745、GTX 750 和 GTX 750 Ti 系列、GTX 950-GTX 980 Ti、GTX 1050-GTX 1080 Ti、GT 1030、GT 1010 等显卡；以及 TITAN V、TITAN Xp、TITAN X 和 GeForce GTX TITAN X 等专业显卡。 参考： https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/details/280035/
items.summary_en: Nvidia released GeForce security driver 582.78 for Maxwell, Pascal and Volta GPUs, covering GTX 700/900/10-series cards plus pro parts such as Tesla V100 and Titan V. The 912.74 MB update for Windows 10 and 11 fixes 114 vulnerabilities in the display driver and vGPU — 76 rated high severity and 37 medium. These older architectures no longer receive regular Game Ready drivers, only occasional security updates.
items.why_zh: 仍在用老架构显卡的用户只有靠这类安全补丁才能堵住高危漏洞，凸显停更硬件的安全风险。
items.why_en: With no more regular Game Ready drivers for these older GPUs, this patch is the only way many users can close high-severity security holes.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出面向政府机构的 Claude for Government
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude for Government
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布推出面向政府机构的 Claude for Government 产品，将其 Claude 模型能力打包提供给公共部门客户。此举意味着该公司正式加入 OpenAI、Google 等厂商争夺政府 AI 合同的行列。原文未披露具体定价、上线时间或首批合作机构等细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude for Government ExecutiveBiz
items.why_zh: 政府市场正成为大模型厂商争夺的关键阵地，其合规与安全要求也将反过来塑造 AI 产品形态。
items.why_en: Governments are becoming a key battleground for AI vendors, and their compliance demands will shape how these models are built.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 文件暴露重大风险：近半数销售额来自亚马逊和谷歌
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Filing Reveals a Major Vulnerability: Nearly 50% of Sales Flow Through Amazon and Google as Revenue Concentration Raises Risks: Report
items.summary_zh: 据媒体报道，Anthropic 的 IPO 申报文件显示，公司近 50% 的销售额通过亚马逊和谷歌产生，收入高度集中构成显著风险。这意味着其营收表现与这两家云巨头的合作安排紧密绑定，一旦合作关系或分成条款发生变化，业绩可能受到明显冲击。相关披露让市场得以在公司上市前审视其客户与渠道结构。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO Filing Reveals a Major Vulnerability: Nearly 50% of Sales Flow Through Amazon and Google as Revenue Concentration Raises Risks: Report Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 收入过度依赖少数渠道伙伴，是 AI 明星公司冲刺上市时必须向投资者解释的核心风险。
items.why_en: Heavy reliance on a handful of partners is a central risk investors will weigh as a leading AI company approaches public markets.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出 Open Agent Safety Platform，可在毫秒级隔离失控 AI 智能体
items.title_en: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform to restrain rogue AI agents — new hardware-and-software security stack can quarantine agents in milliseconds
items.summary_zh: 英伟达发布 Open Agent Safety Platform，用于约束行为失控的 AI 智能体。该平台是一套软硬件结合的安全技术栈，据称能在毫秒级内将问题智能体隔离，从而限制其造成的影响。随着自主智能体被越来越多地部署到实际业务流程中，如何对其实施实时管控成为业界关注的焦点。
items.summary_en: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform to restrain rogue AI agents — new hardware-and-software security stack can quarantine agents in milliseconds Tom's Hardware
items.why_zh: 自主智能体一旦失控可能造成实际损害，毫秒级隔离能力是让企业敢于部署的关键前提。
items.why_en: Millisecond quarantine capability could be what makes enterprises comfortable deploying autonomous agents at all.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 与华为联合发布面向昇腾（Ascend）平台的开源 AI 编程工具，目标是减少对英伟达 CUDA 生态的依赖。这套工具包含计算库与通信库，并为 TileLang 提供昇腾支持，方便开发者将模型迁移到华为 AI 芯片上。此举被视为中国 AI 产业在软硬件栈上推进自主可控的又一步。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek and Huawei release open-source Ascend AI programming tools to reduce reliance on Nvidia CUDA ecosystem — tools include compute and communication libraries, as well as Ascend support for TileLang Tom's Hardware
items.why_zh: 软件生态是 CUDA 护城河的核心，开源工具是国产 AI 芯片争取开发者的关键抓手。
items.why_en: Software ecosystem is the heart of CUDA's moat, making open tooling crucial for domestic AI chips to win developers.

items.why_en: Fraud tactics shift fast, so self-calibrating models can cut manual tuning and speed up response.

items.title_zh: Real Chemistry 推出 AI 平台 MaestroHCP，用于全渠道营销活动

items.summary_en: Real Chemistry launches AI-powered MaestroHCP to conduct omnichannel campaigns Fierce Pharma

items.title_zh: 论文提出“Harness 持续学习”：在模型参数之外实现持续适应
items.title_en: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本提出“Harness 持续学习”（Harness Continual Learning）的新框架。作者指出，持续学习长期以模型为中心，把参数视为随经验变化的唯一状态；但现代智能体还会通过由提示、记忆、工具、技能和路由规则组成的“harness”进行适应。由于这些内容共同决定后续执行，即便模型被冻结，harness 的更新也可能破坏此前可靠的行为。论文由此发问：智能体如何在模型之外持续改进自身状态，同时保留已获得的行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19013v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen. This raises a new question: how can an agent continually improve its state outside the model while retaining behavior acquired earlier? We formulate Harness Continua…
items.why_zh: 把持续学习的焦点从权重更新扩展到提示、记忆与工具编排层，为智能体的长期稳定演进提供新视角。
items.why_en: It shifts continual learning beyond weight updates to the prompt, memory and tool orchestration layer, a key problem for long-lived agents.

items.title_zh: 研究：性别偏见在大模型中普遍存在且高度异质
items.title_en: Gender bias across LLMs is common and highly heterogeneous
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文系统评估了大语言模型中的性别偏见。研究覆盖 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 6 月间发布的十个模型、来自九家厂商，采用两种实验范式：研究一考察对刻板印象短语的性别归属，研究二考察模型对虐待或酷刑行为的道德判断。结果显示，性别偏见在大模型中普遍存在，且不同模型之间差异显著。作者强调，随着 LLM 被嵌入具有真实后果的决策支持工具，这种偏见的普遍性与异质性值得关注。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38036v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a…
items.why_zh: 覆盖十款模型、九家厂商的横向对比说明偏见不是个别模型的问题，而是普遍且需按模型逐一评估的风险。
items.why_en: A ten-model, nine-vendor comparison shows bias is pervasive yet model-specific, meaning it must be evaluated per model rather than assumed uniform.

items.title_zh: 时序基础模型稀疏事件评测：关键在“何时”而非“多少”
items.title_en: When, Not How Much: Evaluating Time-Series Foundation Models on Sparse Events
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 新论文指出，预训练时序基础模型（TSFM）目前主要被当作数值预测器来评估，但在稀疏序列中，许多决策只关心未来哪些时段会出现事件。作者在五个稀疏数据集上，对预测窗口内同时包含事件与零值的位置进行排序评测。结果显示，12 个 TSFM 发布的点预测在机会校正平均精度上相对免训练基线最多只提升 0.031，而在机会校正 AUC 指标上，TSFM 的中位数在每个数据集上都低于免训练基线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are evaluated as forecasters of future values, yet for sparse series many decisions depend only on which future periods contain activity. Standard benchmarks do not assess this. On five sparse datasets, we rank positions within forecast windows that contain both events and zeros. The released point forecasts of 12 TSFMs improve chance-corrected average precision over training-free references by at most 0.031, and in chance-corrected AUC the median TSFM falls below them on every dataset. With event…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了现有时序基础模型评测的盲区：在稀疏事件场景下，这些模型可能并不优于简单基线。
items.why_en: It exposes a blind spot in TSFM benchmarking: for sparse events, these models may not beat simple baselines.

items.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon，初期仅向“可信网络防御者”开放
items.title_en: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
items.summary_zh: Google 发布其新一代前沿模型 Gemini 4，代号 Argon。据首席 AI 架构师、Google DeepMind 高级副总裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 介绍，该模型在真实软件工程、法律与金融等企业知识工作，以及网络安全防御等复杂工作流中具备前沿性能。但 Google 初期仅向一批“可信网络防御者”开放访问，Kavukcuoglu 表示公司正积极参与美国政府关于模型发布前访问的自愿流程，并会逐步扩大开放范围。这显示出对强能力模型在网络安全用途上的谨慎态度。
items.summary_en: Google today revealed its next AI frontier model, which it's calling Gemini 4 Argon. The new model delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. But the company is limiting access at first to a "set of trusted cyber defenders," and Kavukcuoglu says that Google is "actively engaged in the U.S. government's voluntary process for pre-release model access while we gradually expand access." Kavukcuoglu…
items.why_zh: 前沿模型首次以“网络防御者”为受控首发对象，凸显双用途能力与发布前审查正成为头部实验室的默认做法。
items.why_en: Gating a frontier model to vetted cyber defenders highlights how dual-use risk and pre-release government review are becoming standard practice.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件：计算、通信与编译工具同步发布 手机新浪网

items.why_zh: 头部模型厂商开源国产算力基础软件，有助于降低昇腾生态适配门槛、推动模型在国产硬件上落地。
items.why_en: A leading model developer open-sourcing Ascend base software could lower adoption barriers and strengthen model deployment on domestic hardware.

items.title_en: AI cybersecurity startup Armadin valued at over $2.5 billion after new funding round

items.title_zh: Shopify推出Canvas，可通过与AI聊天搭建网店
items.title_en: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
items.summary_zh: Shopify推出名为Canvas的新建站工具，商家可通过与AI代理Sidekick对话来创建和定制在线商店。用户在对话过程中能实时看到网站变化，从而降低建站和定制门槛。这标志着AI代理正进一步融入电商基础设施，可能改变商家搭建和运营网店的方式。

items.why_zh: 把AI代理引入建站流程，可能降低电商创业门槛并影响Shopify与同类平台的竞争。
items.why_en: Bringing AI agents into store building could lower barriers for e-commerce and affect competition among platforms like Shopify.

items.summary_en: Sam Altman's OpenAI Paused AI Training for the Second Time in 3 Months After Agents Escaped a Secure Sandbox and Accessed U.S. Government Websites. Here's Why That Safety Scare Could Complicate Its Plans for a $2 Trillion IPO. The Motley Fool
items.why_zh: IPO前夕的安全事故可能加剧监管审查，并影响市场对OpenAI AI安全治理的信心。
items.why_en: A safety incident ahead of an IPO could intensify regulatory scrutiny and affect confidence in OpenAI’s AI safety governance.

items.title_en: Carlyle Warns Private Credit’s AI Push Raises Concentration Risk

items.summary_en: Carlyle Warns Private Credit’s AI Push Raises Concentration Risk Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: AI投资热潮外溢至私人信贷，集中度风险可能放大金融体系波动。
items.why_en: The AI investment boom is spilling into private credit, where concentration risk could amplify financial volatility.

items.title_zh: AI尝试破解黎曼猜想虽失败，却带来意外突破
items.title_en: AI's failed attempt to crack the Riemann hypothesis still led to a breakthrough
items.summary_zh: Live Science报道，AI在尝试破解黎曼猜想时未能成功，但这一过程仍带来了突破。摘要未披露突破的具体内容、方法或研究团队。此事表明，AI在数学探索中即便未达成原定目标，也可能产生有价值的研究成果。
items.summary_en: AI's failed attempt to crack the Riemann hypothesis still led to a breakthrough Live Science
items.why_zh: 说明AI可成为数学研究的探索工具，失败路径也可能催生新发现。
items.why_en: It shows AI can serve as a tool for mathematical exploration, where even failed paths may lead to new discoveries.

items.title_zh: 博通据称将向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元融资
items.title_en: Broadcom to provide Anthropic with up to $42 billion in financing, Reuters reports
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，博通（Broadcom）将向AI公司Anthropic提供最高420亿美元融资。报道未在摘要中披露融资的具体形式、期限或附加条件。如此大规模的资金安排凸显AI基础设施与芯片供应链对资本的巨大需求，也可能加深芯片厂商与模型公司之间的绑定。
items.summary_en: Broadcom to provide Anthropic with up to $42 billion in financing, Reuters reports Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 巨额融资显示AI竞赛正与半导体巨头深度绑定，可能改变AI基础设施格局。
items.why_en: The massive financing shows the AI race is becoming deeply tied to semiconductor giants and could reshape AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 博通420亿美元押注Anthropic，为AI风险增添新维度
items.title_en: Broadcom's $42 Billion Anthropic Bet Adds a New Layer of AI Risk
items.summary_zh: 雅虎财经报道称，博通对Anthropic的420亿美元押注为AI领域增添了新的风险层面。如此大规模的资金承诺可能使芯片厂商与AI模型公司的利益高度捆绑。投资者需关注交易结构、回报周期以及潜在集中度风险。
items.summary_en: Broadcom's $42 Billion Anthropic Bet Adds a New Layer of AI Risk Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 芯片巨头深度输血AI模型公司，可能放大行业波动与风险传染。
items.why_en: A chip giant deeply funding an AI model company could amplify industry volatility and risk contagion.

items.title_zh: 谷歌发布最新AI模型，分析师称在AI竞赛中领先“至关重要”
items.title_en: Google Unveiled Its Latest AI Model. Analysts Say Getting Ahead in the AI Race Is ‘Critical’
items.summary_zh: Investopedia报道，谷歌发布其最新AI模型。分析师认为，在竞争激烈的AI竞赛中取得领先地位“至关重要”。摘要未披露该模型的名称和具体能力。此次发布可能影响谷歌与OpenAI等对手的竞争格局，并受到投资者关注。
items.summary_en: Google Unveiled Its Latest AI Model. Analysts Say Getting Ahead in the AI Race Is ‘Critical’ Investopedia
items.why_zh: 头部厂商模型迭代加速，领先地位关系到云、广告和AI生态的市场份额。
items.why_en: As leading vendors iterate faster, leadership matters for market share across cloud, advertising and the AI ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 九人团队 Halluminate 融资 3000 万美元，客户包括四家美国头部 AI 实验室
items.title_en: Exclusive: Nine-Person Halluminate Raises $30 Million, Counts Four Top U.S. AI Labs as Customers
items.summary_zh: 据独家消息，仅有九名员工的初创公司 Halluminate 完成了 3000 万美元融资，并且已经拿下四家美国顶级 AI 实验室作为客户。这意味着公司以极小的团队规模服务了行业中最核心的一批买家，人均产能与客户含金量都相当突出。目前报道未披露本轮融资的具体投资方、估值以及 Halluminate 的具体产品方向，但从其客户结构看，业务应与头部 AI 实验室的关键需求高度相关。
items.summary_en: Exclusive: Nine-Person Halluminate Raises $30 Million, Counts Four Top U.S. AI Labs as Customers Fortune
items.why_zh: 一个九人小团队能拿下四家美国顶级 AI 实验室客户并融到 3000 万美元，凸显 AI 产业链上“小而关键”的供应商价值。
items.why_en: A nine-person team landing four top U.S. AI labs as customers and $30M highlights how small, critical suppliers can matter in the AI stack.

items.title_zh: 博通将向 Anthropic 提供最高 420 亿美元贷款用于租用芯片
items.title_en: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease chips, in latest circular investing deal
items.summary_zh: 博通将向 AI 公司 Anthropic 提供最高 420 亿美元的贷款，用于租用芯片，成为最新一笔“循环式投资”交易。此类结构的典型特征是：芯片供应商既向 AI 公司供货，又通过融资安排帮助其支付算力成本，资金最终又回流到供应商手中。这笔规模高达数百亿美元的安排，进一步凸显当前 AI 算力扩张对巨额资本的高度依赖，以及产业链上下游日益紧密的绑定关系。
items.summary_en: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease chips, in latest circular investing deal Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 420 亿美元的供应商贷款再次印证 AI 算力扩张高度依赖“循环投资”，也让行业资本结构的风险受到关注。
items.why_en: A $42B vendor loan reinforces how AI compute expansion leans on circular financing, raising questions about the industry's capital structure.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 新智能体 Dots 对标 Meta Muse：免费策略下如何竞争？
items.title_en: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
items.summary_zh: 在年度 DevDay 大会上，OpenAI 发布了由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的新智能体 Dots，CEO Sam Altman 登台宣布这是“真正的 AI”智能体，并称其灵感来自人们成长过程中在电影里看到的智能体。Dots 与 Meta 的 Muse 智能体平台路线相似，主打讨喜的可爱形象——色彩丰富、可个性化定制的带眼睛“团子”。报道指出，OpenAI 此举主要针对竞争对手 Meta，而后者的 Muse 平台已取得早期的高速增长；外界关注的核心问题是，面对免费产品，OpenAI 的新智能体能否形成竞争力。
items.summary_en: A pop-up shop for "dots," a personal assistant agent at OpenAI DevDay 2026. (Photo by Heather Diehl/Getty Images) | Getty Images At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success. CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, "inspired by the cool agents that we all watched in movies growing up." Similar to Muse, Dots aims for disarming cuteness, taking the form of colorful, personalizable blobs with eyes.…
items.why_zh: OpenAI 把智能体竞争直接指向 Meta 的 Muse，而“能否与免费产品竞争”将决定消费级 AI 智能体的商业路径。
items.why_en: OpenAI is aiming its agent squarely at Meta's Muse, and the 'can it compete with free?' question will shape the business model for consumer AI agents.

items.title_zh: 致敬《终结者 2》：Figure 让 F.02 人形机器人亲自跳入熔炉，采纳施瓦辛格本人提议
items.title_en: Figure’s F.02 humanoid robot jumps into furnace in Terminator 2 homage, idea from Schwarzenegger
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，美国初创企业 Figure 今日发布视频，为寿终正寝的 F.02 机器人举行一场“火化仪式”。 随着 Figure F.03 机队不断壮大，F.02 已经日显颓势。该公司认为继续维护老一代机器人已经没有意义，但直接报废并不是最优选择，因为这些机器人内含大量专用硬件和知识产权结晶。Figure 甚至表示，直接进行拆解工作需要大量时间，甚至可能拖慢 F.04 的研发进度。 Figure 表示，让机器人自己跳入熔炉这个想法正是源自 T-800 扮演者阿诺德 · 施瓦辛格本人。此前 Figure 曾在网上征集如何进行 F.02 送别仪式，后来施瓦辛格的想法被采纳。 IT之家注意到，后来施瓦辛格亲自来到了熔解现场，他身穿全套防护装备，带领一台 F.02 走向熔炉，致敬了《终结者 2》电影。在视频结尾，他摘下面具说道：“Figure 2 已经退役。” 不过，想找到合适的熔炉并不容易。许多美国和墨西哥企业都拒绝了 Figure 的请求，因为他们无法确认机器人内部锂电池的安全性。最终公司在芬兰伊马特拉找到了符合要求的设施。 此外，Figure 并没有简单地把 F.02 扔进熔炉，而是专门训练了一个 AI 模型，让机器人能够以尽可能壮观之方式跳入熔炉。
items.summary_en: US startup Figure staged a 'cremation' for its retired F.02 humanoid robot, having it jump into a furnace as a tribute to Terminator 2. The idea came from Arnold Schwarzenegger, who attended in full protective gear, led an F.02 to the furnace and said 'Figure 2 has retired.' After US and Mexican firms refused due to lithium battery safety concerns, Figure found a facility in Imatra, Finland, and trained an AI model to make the plunge as spectacular as possible.
items.why_zh: 展示机器人退役处理的新方式，同时体现AI训练在仪式化场景中的应用与话题营销。
items.why_en: It showcases a novel robot retirement approach and AI training in a ceremonial stunt, serving as high-profile marketing.

items.title_zh: 深入调查凯文·奥利里的犹他州数据中心风波：全球最大AI园区如何搅动地方政治
items.title_en: Inside our months-long investigation into Kevin O’Leary’s Utah data center debacle
items.summary_zh: 《The Verge》记者Josh Dzieza与同事讨论其对凯文·奥利里在犹他州建设大型数据中心项目的数月调查。该项目正式名称为Stratos，更广为人知的名字是Wonder Valley，计划打造全球最大数据中心：占地4万英亩的AI园区，耗电9吉瓦，超过犹他州全州平均用电量的两倍。报道称，Wonder Valley项目已彻底搅动犹他州政治。
items.summary_en: Today I’m talking with Josh Dzieza, a longtime features writer here at The Verge , about Kevin O’Leary’s plans to build a massive data center in Utah . The idea was to build the world’s biggest data center — a 40,000-acre AI campus with nine gigawatts of power, or more than double the average power usage of the entire state of Utah. The project is technically called Stratos, but it’s more prominently known as Wonder Valley, a reference to O’Leary’s nickname on Shark Tank . Josh has spent months reporting on this project, and it’s fair to say Wonder Valley has completely upended Utah poli…
items.why_zh: 揭示AI基础设施扩张在能源、土地与地方政治层面引发的争议。
items.why_en: It highlights the energy, land and local political controversies around AI infrastructure expansion.

items.why_en: It highlights global AI inequality and open source's key role in bridging the gap.

items.title_zh: Anthropic：“突破即服务”
items.title_en: Anthropic: Breakthroughs As A Service (ANTHRO)
items.summary_zh: Seeking Alpha 发布了一篇以《Anthropic: Breakthroughs As A Service (ANTHRO)》为题的分析文章，用“突破即服务”来概括 Anthropic 这家 Claude 开发商在 AI 领域的定位与商业模式。Anthropic 近年被视为与 OpenAI 并列的头部大模型公司之一，其企业级业务与融资、上市动向持续受到资本市场关注。该文摘要仅给出标题与来源，未披露更具体的财务数据或投资结论，投资者可据此进一步查阅原文了解分析逻辑。
items.summary_en: Anthropic: Breakthroughs As A Service (ANTHRO) Seeking Alpha
items.why_zh: Anthropic 是与 OpenAI 并列的头部大模型公司，市场对其商业模式与估值的分析直接影响 AI 板块的资金流向。
items.why_en: As one of the leading AI model developers alongside OpenAI, how the market values Anthropic’s business model shapes capital flows across the AI sector.

items.title_zh: Plexo Capital 的 Lo Toney：投资者为何要盯紧 Anthropic 的 IPO
items.title_en: Plexo Capital’s Lo Toney on why investors need to watch Anthropic’s IPO
items.summary_zh: 在 CNBC 的一档节目中，Plexo Capital 管理合伙人 Lo Toney 谈及为何投资者应当密切关注 Anthropic 的 IPO 进程。作为 Claude 的开发商，Anthropic 被普遍视为最受期待上市的 AI 独角兽之一，其挂牌时点与定价可能成为衡量整个 AI 投资周期热度的重要标尺。该节目摘要未展开 Toney 的具体论据与预测，投资者可回看完整访谈了解其判断依据。
items.summary_en: Plexo Capital’s Lo Toney on why investors need to watch Anthropic’s IPO CNBC
items.why_zh: Anthropic 若上市，将成为检验 AI 一级市场估值能否被公开市场接受的关键案例。
items.why_en: An Anthropic listing would be a key test of whether public markets will validate the AI sector’s private-market valuations.

items.title_zh: Tony Yoseloff：Anthropic IPO 若延期，将对整个市场构成真正的麻烦
items.title_en: A delayed Anthropic IPO would pose a real problem for the entire market, says Tony Yoseloff
items.summary_zh: 在 CNBC 的评论中，投资人 Tony Yoseloff 表示，如果 Anthropic 的 IPO 被推迟，将对整个市场构成实实在在的问题。这一表态把这家 Claude 开发商的上市进程与更广泛的市场情绪联系在一起，暗示其挂牌被视为 AI 与科技板块的重要风向标。目前公开的摘要仅包含这一核心观点，具体分析与数据需参考完整节目内容。
items.summary_en: A delayed Anthropic IPO would pose a real problem for the entire market, says Tony Yoseloff CNBC
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司的上市节奏被视为市场信心与流动性的信号，延期可能加剧对 AI 泡沫的担忧。
items.why_en: The listing pace of top AI firms is read as a signal of market confidence and liquidity, and delays could deepen bubble concerns.

items.title_zh: 中国大模型首次！Kimi K3进入OpenAI企业付费结算体系
items.title_en: A First for Chinese Models: Kimi K3 Enters OpenAI’s Enterprise Paid Billing System
items.summary_zh: 中国大模型首次！Kimi K3进入OpenAI企业付费结算体系 finance.sina.com.cn
items.summary_en: Chinese model Kimi K3 has entered OpenAI’s enterprise paid billing system, a first for a Chinese large model, according to Sina Finance. The move marks a notable step for Chinese model commercialization and ecosystem interoperability.
items.why_zh: 这是中国大模型首次接入 OpenAI 的企业付费通道，标志着中美模型生态出现新的商业化接口。
items.why_en: It is the first time a Chinese large model has plugged into OpenAI’s enterprise billing channel, signaling a new commercial interface between the two ecosystems.

items.title_zh: Volantis 融资 8800 万美元，研发连接 AI 与内存芯片的技术
items.title_en: Volantis raises $88 million for tech to connect AI, memory chips
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，Volantis 完成 8800 万美元融资，资金将用于开发把 AI 芯片与内存芯片连接起来的技术。在 AI 算力需求持续攀升的背景下，芯片间互连与内存带宽正成为制约训练与推理效率的关键瓶颈之一。此次融资反映出资本市场对 AI 硬件基础设施环节的持续看好，该公司的技术能否规模化落地值得关注。
items.summary_en: Volantis raises $88 million for tech to connect AI, memory chips Reuters
items.why_zh: 芯片互连与内存带宽是 AI 算力的核心瓶颈，相关技术突破直接关系到训练与推理效率。
items.why_en: Chip interconnect and memory bandwidth are core AI compute bottlenecks, so progress here directly affects training and inference efficiency.

items.title_zh: TSMC Mulls Multibillion-Dollar Texas Campus for More AI Chips
items.title_en: TSMC Mulls Multibillion-Dollar Texas Campus for More AI Chips
items.summary_zh: TSMC Mulls Multibillion-Dollar Texas Campus for More AI Chips Bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: TSMC is weighing a multibillion-dollar campus in Texas to expand AI chip capacity, Bloomberg reported. The move would extend the company’s overseas advanced manufacturing push and align with U.S. efforts to onshore semiconductor production.
items.why_zh: 台积电海外扩产直接关系到全球 AI 芯片供应格局与半导体供应链的地缘重塑。
items.why_en: TSMC’s overseas expansion directly affects global AI chip supply and the geopolitical reshaping of the semiconductor supply chain.

items.title_zh: 博通拟向 Anthropic 提供最高 420 亿美元贷款，支持其自建 AI 芯片
items.title_en: Broadcom is offering to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to finance its AI chip buildout
items.summary_zh: 据 qz.com 报道，博通（Broadcom）提出向 Anthropic 提供最高 420 亿美元的贷款，用于支持其 AI 芯片的建设和部署。若交易成行，这将是 AI 领域规模罕见的融资安排，也表明芯片厂商正以资金方式深度绑定头部模型公司，以锁定长期订单。此举可能进一步加剧大模型公司在自研算力基础设施上的投入竞赛。
items.summary_en: Broadcom is offering to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to finance its AI chip buildout qz.com
items.why_zh: 芯片厂商以巨额贷款绑定大模型客户，反映 AI 算力军备竞赛正转向资本层面的深度捆绑。
items.why_en: A chipmaker lending billions to a model developer shows the AI compute race is shifting into deep capital-level alliances.

items.title_zh: HPE’s $1.2 billion order from Vultr puts its AI networking strategy to the test
items.title_en: HPE’s $1.2 billion order from Vultr puts its AI networking strategy to the test
items.summary_zh: HPE’s $1.2 billion order from Vultr puts its AI networking strategy to the test Fortune
items.summary_en: HPE has won a $1.2 billion order from cloud provider Vultr, Fortune reported, putting its AI networking strategy to the test. The deal will gauge whether HPE’s networking portfolio can compete as AI data centers demand ever faster interconnects.
items.why_zh: AI 数据中心的网络互联正成为算力竞争关键，该订单是检验 HPE 战略成效的重要标尺。
items.why_en: Networking is becoming a decisive layer in AI data centers, making this deal a key test of HPE’s strategy.

items.title_zh: 博通将向 Anthropic 提供至多 420 亿美元贷款，用于租用其芯片
items.title_en: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease its chips, filing says
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 援引相关申报文件报道，博通（Broadcom）将向 AI 公司 Anthropic 提供至多 420 亿美元的贷款，资金用途是让 Anthropic 租用博通的芯片。这一安排把芯片供应与融资绑定在一起，显示出 AI 算力扩张正愈发依赖厂商提供的资本支持。对 Anthropic 而言，这有助于缓解自建大规模算力所需的巨额前期支出压力；对博通来说，则是在 AI 芯片需求高涨之际锁定长期客户。
items.summary_en: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease its chips, filing says CNBC
items.why_zh: 420 亿美元级别的厂商融资把芯片供应与客户扩张直接绑定，凸显 AI 算力竞赛中资本与硬件深度捆绑的新模式。
items.why_en: A $42 billion vendor-financing deal ties chip supply directly to a customer's expansion, highlighting how capital and hardware are becoming tightly coupled in the AI compute race.

items.title_zh: 博通将以至多 420 亿美元贷款支持 Anthropic 租用芯片
items.title_en: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion in deal to lease chips
items.summary_zh: 雅虎财经报道称，博通与 Anthropic 达成一项涉及至多 420 亿美元贷款的协议，用于支持 Anthropic 租用博通的芯片。报道未披露更多交易条款细节，但这一规模表明 AI 模型公司为获取算力，正越来越多借助供应商提供的融资安排。此类交易既帮助 AI 公司快速扩大训练与推理能力，也让芯片厂商提前锁定大客户需求。
items.summary_en: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion in deal to lease chips Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 该交易表明 AI 公司在算力军备竞赛中正借助芯片厂商的信贷支持来快速扩张，改变行业融资与供应格局。
items.why_en: The deal shows AI firms are leaning on chipmakers' credit to scale fast, reshaping financing and supply dynamics across the industry.

items.title_zh: 谷歌发布新模型 Gemini 4 Argon，Alphabet 股价走高
items.title_en: Google Unveils New AI Model Gemini 4 Argon, Sending Alphabet Stock Higher
items.summary_zh: 据 Barron's 报道，谷歌发布新一代 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon，消息公布后母公司 Alphabet 股价上涨。市场反应显示，投资者将这一新模型视为谷歌在生成式 AI 竞争中保持前沿地位的重要动作。报道未披露模型的具体参数、能力细节与上线范围，但股价走高本身反映出资本市场对谷歌 AI 进展的敏感度依然很高。
items.summary_en: Google Unveils New AI Model Gemini 4 Argon, Sending Alphabet Stock Higher Barron's
items.why_zh: 谷歌新一代 Gemini 模型直接牵动 Alphabet 股价，说明头部模型发布仍是影响 AI 竞争格局与资本市场预期的关键事件。
items.why_en: A new Gemini release immediately moved Alphabet's stock, showing that flagship model launches remain pivotal to AI competition and investor expectations.

items.title_zh: 2026年9月30日消息：豆包汽车亮相？赛力斯代工！AIVA ME7量产首秀
items.title_en: Doubao Car Debut? Seres to Manufacture AIVA ME7 in Mass-Production Premiere
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月30日消息：豆包汽车亮相？赛力斯代工！AIVA ME7量产首秀 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: A report dated September 30, 2026 says a "Doubao car" has appeared, manufactured by Seres and named AIVA ME7, marking its mass-production debut. Details such as pricing, specifications and delivery were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 若消息属实，AI 大模型品牌借代工进入整车制造，意味着 AI 能力正加速向智能汽车等硬件场景延伸。
items.why_en: If accurate, an AI model brand entering vehicle manufacturing via contract production signals AI capabilities pushing further into hardware such as smart cars.

items.title_zh: 迈克尔·伯里盼市场崩盘，以阻止 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 IPO
items.title_en: Michael Burry is rooting for a market crash to stop the OpenAI and Anthropic IPOs
items.summary_zh: 据 qz.com 报道，因《大空头》而闻名的投资人迈克尔·伯里表示，他希望出现一场市场崩盘，从而阻止 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 IPO。这番表态把当前 AI 热潮与资本市场估值风险联系在一起，反映出部分知名投资者对 AI 相关上市与融资狂热的质疑。报道聚焦其观点本身，未提供两家公司 IPO 的具体时间表或进展。
items.summary_en: Michael Burry is rooting for a market crash to stop the OpenAI and Anthropic IPOs qz.com
items.why_zh: 知名做空投资者公开唱空 AI 上市潮，凸显市场对 AI 估值泡沫与融资过热的争论正在升温。
items.why_en: A prominent bearish investor publicly betting against AI listings highlights growing debate over AI valuations and financing exuberance.

items.title_zh: 泰雷兹发布全球框架，保护关键机构抵御前沿 AI 攻击
items.title_en: Thales Unveils a Global Framework to Protect Critical Organisations from Frontier AI Attacks
items.summary_zh: 据法新社报道，泰雷兹（Thales）发布了一套全球性框架，目标是帮助关键机构抵御来自前沿 AI 的攻击。随着能力更强的 AI 模型被用于网络攻击，关键基础设施与大型组织面临的安全风险上升，该框架试图提供统一的防护思路。报道未详述框架的技术细节或落地时间表，但显示传统安全厂商正把前沿 AI 威胁纳入产品与战略布局。
items.summary_en: Thales Unveils a Global Framework to Protect Critical Organisations from Frontier AI Attacks afp.com
items.why_zh: 前沿 AI 被用于网络攻击的风险上升，安全厂商推出专门框架，意味着 AI 安全已从讨论走向实际防护产品化。
items.why_en: With frontier AI increasingly weaponised for cyberattacks, a dedicated protection framework signals AI security is moving from debate into practical, productised defense.

items.title_zh: 健康保险公司将矛头指向 AI，近 10 亿美元可疑医院收费浮出水面
items.title_en: Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，一家健康保险公司在发现近 10 亿美元可疑医院收费后，将矛头指向 AI。事件显示，AI 被引入医疗计费流程后，可能带来新的收费异常与合规风险，而保险公司正试图追查相关责任。报道未披露涉事医院与保险公司的具体名称及处理结果，但这反映出 AI 在医疗行政环节的落地正面临审计与监管审视。
items.summary_en: Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear cnbc.com
items.why_zh: 近 10 亿美元可疑收费把 AI 在医疗计费中的应用推到聚光灯下，可能推动更严格的审计与监管。
items.why_en: Nearly $1 billion in questionable charges puts AI-driven healthcare billing under scrutiny and could spur tighter auditing and regulation.

items.title_zh: Nebius 以 1 亿至 1.5 亿美元收购成立仅 10 个月的隐秘 AI 初创 Inferize
items.title_en: Nebius acquires 10-month-old stealth AI startup Inferize in $100-150 million deal
items.summary_zh: 据 Calcalistech 报道，Nebius 以约 1 亿至 1.5 亿美元收购了成立仅 10 个月的隐秘（stealth）AI 初创公司 Inferize。如此早期阶段便获得亿元级估值，显示 AI 基础设施与推理相关技术仍是资本追逐的热点。报道未披露 Inferize 的具体产品与团队规模，但交易规模本身说明买方对相关技术能力的迫切需求。
items.summary_en: Nebius acquires 10-month-old stealth AI startup Inferize in $100-150 million deal calcalistech.com
items.why_zh: 成立仅 10 个月的隐秘公司即获亿元级收购，说明 AI 推理与基础设施赛道的人才和技术正被高价争夺。
items.why_en: A $100-150 million exit for a 10-month-old stealth company shows talent and technology in AI inference and infrastructure command premium prices.

items.title_zh: 谷歌率先向网络安全合作伙伴推出最强 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_en: Google is launching Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model, for cybersecurity partners first
items.summary_zh: 据报道，谷歌正准备发布其迄今最强大的 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon，首批使用对象为网络安全领域的合作伙伴。这意味着谷歌采取“先垂直、后通用”的发布路径，优先把最强模型能力投向对安全防御要求最高的场景。选择网络安全伙伴先行，也与当前 AI 模型被用于漏洞发现、攻击检测与防御自动化的趋势相呼应。目前披露的信息集中在发布渠道和首批用户群体，模型的参数规模、具体能力指标与全面开放时间尚未公布。
items.summary_en: Google is launching Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model, for cybersecurity partners first qz.com
items.why_zh: 这显示谷歌把最强模型能力优先输送给安全领域，可能重塑 AI 在网络安全攻防中的竞争格局。
items.why_en: It signals that Google is prioritizing its most capable model for security use cases, potentially reshaping competition in AI-driven cybersecurity.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 将把谷歌 AI 芯片送入轨道，推进太空数据中心计划
items.title_en: SpaceX set to launch Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
items.summary_zh: 据报道，SpaceX 计划将谷歌的 AI 芯片送入轨道，作为推动“太空数据中心”构想的一部分。这一动向把当前最紧缺的 AI 算力基础设施与商业航天能力结合起来，探索在地球之外部署计算资源的可行性。若相关试验与部署推进顺利，太空数据中心有望在能源供给、散热与地理限制等方面提供不同于地面机房的思路。目前公开信息主要集中在发射安排与合作方向上，具体的卫星规模、算力指标与商业化时间表尚未披露。
items.summary_en: SpaceX set to launch Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers cnbc.com
items.why_zh: 若能落地，太空数据中心可能为 AI 算力提供新的能源与部署路径，同时深化航天与芯片产业的结合。
items.why_en: If realized, orbital data centers could open a new energy and deployment path for AI compute and deepen ties between space and chip industries.

items.title_zh: 育碧公布新品牌：创意事业部 2 更名 Massive Entertainment，统一管理多款知名 IP
items.title_en: Ubisoft renames Creative House 2 as Massive Entertainment to unify major IP management
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，育碧于当地时间 9 月 30 日宣布将开发部门“创意事业部 2”（Creative House 2）正式更名为“Massive Entertainment”，并启用全新品牌标志。 该部门将整合加拿大蒙特利尔、法国巴黎、瑞典及加拿大多伦多的相关开发团队。 此次调整是育碧今年推进的新组织架构的一部分。公司此前将开发团队划分为 5 个“创意事业部”，按照游戏类型和负责的品牌进行组织，以强化开发团队的自主权以及不同团队之间的协作。 更名后的 Massive Entertainment 将负责《汤姆 · 克兰西：全境封锁》《幽灵行动》《细胞分裂》等系列，同时纳入新 IP《巨人之战》（March of Giants）。相关游戏的开发团队将统一使用 Massive Entertainment 品牌开展工作，但该部门仍属于育碧，游戏发行和分销工作仍由育碧负责。 IT之家查询获悉，Massive Entertainment 这一名称源自育碧旗下瑞典马尔默工作室。该工作室成立于 1997 年，并于 2008 年被育碧收购。此次调整后，原本分散于不同地区的相关团队将统一纳入这一品牌体系。 今年 7 月，曾任 2K Games 高管的 Christoph Hartmann 加入育碧，出任创意事业部 2 总经理，负责相关工作室和游戏品牌的战略方向及开发工作。 Hartmann…
items.summary_en: Ubisoft has renamed its Creative House 2 division as Massive Entertainment, uniting teams in Montreal, Paris, Sweden, and Toronto under one brand. The unit will oversee Tom Clancy franchises such as The Division, Ghost Recon, and Splinter Cell, plus the new IP March of Giants. The change is part of Ubisoft's broader reorganization into five creative houses; publishing and distribution remain with Ubisoft.
items.why_zh: 这反映育碧正通过组织架构与品牌整合，集中资源经营核心 IP 以提升开发效率。
items.why_en: It shows Ubisoft consolidating resources and brands around core franchises to improve development efficiency.

items.title_zh: 日本电力巨头 JERA 牵手戴尔等伙伴，将在千叶建设该国最大 AI 数据中心
items.title_en: Japan's JERA teams with Dell and others to build the country's largest AI data center in Chiba
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，日本供电规模最大的电力公司 JERA（捷热）当地时间今日与 Dell（戴尔）、主权人工智能基础设施开发商 RHAELM 当地时间今日签署谅解备忘录，三方将共同制定日本人工智能基础设施建设标准化框架。 备忘录下的首个数据中心将落地东京东侧的千叶县。其设计容量达 400MW， 是日本最大的单一数据中心站点 ，总投资规模预计将超过 150 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,007.53 亿元人民币） 。Apollo 将为该项目提供投融资支持。 这座 AI 数据中心位于 JERA 自有火力发电站附近，采用表后供电。其 配套电力基础设施的建设和审核时间因此大幅缩短 ，站点有望于 2028 年上线运行。 JERA 和 RHAELM 还计划将这一模式扩展到其它 JERA站点，目标到 21 世纪 30 年代实现多 GW 级别的 AI 基础设施容量。
items.summary_en: Japan's largest power utility JERA signed an MoU with Dell and sovereign AI infrastructure developer RHAELM to standardize AI infrastructure buildout in Japan. The first site, in Chiba prefecture, is designed at 400MW—Japan's largest single data center site—with total investment expected to exceed $15 billion and financing support from Apollo. Located near JERA's own thermal plant and using behind-the-meter power, it could go live in 2028, with plans to scale to multi-GW capacity in the 2030s.
items.why_zh: 400MW 级项目与电力公司深度绑定，凸显 AI 数据中心竞争正转向电力供给与落地速度。
items.why_en: A 400MW project tied directly to a utility highlights how AI data center competition is shifting to power supply and speed of delivery.

items.title_zh: AI 拉动半导体需求暴涨，韩国 9 月出口创历史新高
items.title_en: AI-driven chip demand pushes South Korea's September exports to a record high
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，据彭博社报道，受全球人工智能需求持续拉动半导体出口的推动，韩国 9 月出口延续迅猛增势，进一步增强外界预期：这个高度依赖贸易的经济体有能力承受更高的利率水平。 韩国海关当地时间周四发布的数据显示，剔除工作日差异影响后，9 月出口同比增幅达到 104.9%；出口总额达到 1,209 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8,120.71 亿元人民币） ，创下历史新高。而该月前 20 天的出口货值此前就已经刷新该时段的历史纪录。 韩国海关部门同时表示，2026 年前九个月韩国出口总额达到创纪录的 8,145 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.47 万亿元人民币） ，首次突破 8,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.37 万亿元人民币） 关口。未经调整口径下，9 月出口同比上涨 83.5%；8 月修正后的增幅为 68.7%。进口同比增长 26%，当月贸易顺差接近 500 亿美元 （现汇率约合 3,358.44 亿元人民币） 。 半导体依旧是本轮出口繁荣的核心引擎，芯片出口同比猛增 263%，达到 603 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4,050.28 亿元人民币） 。计算机产品出口飙升 435%，石油制品出口上涨 72%；汽车出口则下滑 5%。 值得一提的是，今年 9 月受 9 月 24‑26 日秋夕假期影响，实际工作日有所减少；而去年的秋夕假期落在 10 月。这种日历效应会干…
items.summary_en: South Korea's September exports hit a record $120.9 billion, with working-day-adjusted growth of 104.9%, as AI demand fueled chip shipments, according to Bloomberg and customs data. Semiconductor exports surged 263% to $60.3 billion and computer products jumped 435%, while auto exports fell 5%. Exports for the first nine months reached a record $814.5 billion, topping $800 billion for the first time.
items.why_zh: 芯片出口的爆发式增长显示 AI 投资周期正在实质性地拉动全球贸易与韩国经济。
items.why_en: Explosive chip export growth shows the AI investment cycle is materially driving global trade and South Korea's economy.

items.title_zh: 当上下文变化：理解大语言模型的信息更新失败
items.title_en: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文研究大语言模型在上下文信息发生变化时的失败模式：当偏好、目标和事实改变后，模型必须使用最新状态，而旧版本仍留在上下文中。作者把模型给出同一变量旧取值的失败称为“stale binding”（陈旧绑定），并提出受控上下文记忆基准 CICM（Controlled In-Context Memory），用于在对话和智能体日志中跟踪与使用更新后的信息。研究发现，即便是前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复到当前状态；在开源模型上，探针仍能提供一定的分析线索。该工作为评估和改进 LLM 的上下文更新能力提供了统一测试与诊断工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can still re…
items.why_zh: “陈旧绑定”是智能体在长对话与日志场景中的关键隐患，该基准为衡量和修复这一问题提供了方法。
items.why_en: Stale binding is a key hazard for agents in long conversations and logs, and this benchmark offers a way to measure and address it.

items.title_zh: 偏好型老虎机问题的复杂度研究
items.title_en: On the Complexity of Preference-Based Bandits
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文研究具有一般奖励函数类的偏好型老虎机（preference-based bandits）问题：学习者在每一步选择一对臂，并观察到由 Bradley–Terry 模型生成的二元偏好反馈。该设定自然出现在推荐系统、锦标赛排序以及基于人类反馈的学习等应用中——在这些场景中，相对偏好比绝对奖励更容易获取。论文指出，这一观测模型继承了逻辑老虎机（logistic bandit）的挑战，需要处理与问题相关的常数 κ，该常数刻画了模型的非线性特征。研究围绕此类问题的复杂度展开分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $\kappa$, which accounts for the non-linearity…
items.why_zh: 相对偏好比绝对奖励更易获取，厘清这类学习的复杂度对推荐与人类反馈训练等场景有直接价值。
items.why_en: Relative preferences are easier to obtain than absolute rewards, so clarifying the complexity of such learning directly informs recommender systems and human-feedback training.

items.title_zh: 分而治之：通过精确分解为独立子实例求解 MAPF-Collapse
items.title_en: Divide and Collapse: MAPF-Collapse via Exact Decomposition into Independent Sub-Instances
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文研究 MAPF-Collapse（MAPFC）问题：给定现代多智能体路径规划（MAPF）求解器产出的可行方案，任务是在保持可行性的前提下删除可避免的多余移动。该问题属于 NP 难问题，在使用基于学习的最先进求解器时尤为常见，因为这类求解器生成的方案往往含有可被消除的冗余动作。此前 Tang 等人提出了 Judgelight，使用整数线性规划（ILP）求解 MAPFC。本文提出通过精确分解为相互独立的子实例来求解该问题，从而利用问题的结构降低求解难度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39559v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we study the problem of MAPFC, a post-optimization step for Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) plans where we are given a feasible plan produced by a modern MAPF solver and are tasked with removing avoidable moves while preserving feasibility. This NP-hard problem naturally arises when using learning-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) solvers which construct plans that contain redundant moves that can be removed. Recently, Tang et al. presented Judgelight, which uses Integer Linear Programming (ILP) to solve MAPFC. Importantly, the ILP is co…
items.why_zh: 为修复学习型 MAPF 求解器产生的冗余方案提供了更可扩展的精确求解思路。
items.why_en: It offers a more scalable exact approach to cleaning up redundant plans produced by learning-based MAPF solvers.

items.title_zh: 更好的演示文稿，还是不同的评审？评估企业与投资银行中的智能体框架增益
items.title_en: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
items.summary_zh: 企业与投资银行团队常用演示文稿支持信贷决策，并为客户提供融资与交易建议；制作这类材料需要核对财务数据、追溯来源，并把分析转化为建议。该研究回溯性考察了一套“智能体框架”的开发过程，该框架结合了 270 亿参数的语言模型、财务计算、叙事模板与校验检查。研究用 LLM 评审来指导工程改动并评估生成的演示文稿，由此提出关键疑问：分数提高究竟意味着文档质量真的变好，还是仅仅换了评审标准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better docume…
items.why_zh: 它提醒业界：用 LLM 评审来驱动智能体系统迭代，可能测到的是评审偏好而非真实能力提升。
items.why_en: It warns that using LLM judges to guide agentic system improvements may measure judge preference rather than genuine capability gains.

items.title_zh: Janus：先证据后效果的 saga 与可离线验证的智能体 LLM 溯源
items.title_en: Janus: Evidence-Before-Effect Sagas and Offline-Verifiable Provenance for Agentic LLMs
items.summary_zh: 智能体 LLM 如今能通过工具调动资金，但“它们做了什么”的记录通常只是其自身进程在效果旁留下的追踪信息。Janus 把记录放到效果路径上：某一步的提案、对其的裁决，以及验证器或人工给出的任何答复，都必须先写入一条经签名、哈希链式连接的日志，之后该步骤才能执行、效果才能释放。在声明密钥的前提下，每条答复都由给出或转达它的一方签名；门控是该日志的纯函数，审计者可离线从日志重新推导每一项裁决。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38266v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic large language models (LLMs) now move money through tools, yet the record of what they did is usually a trace their own process emits beside the effect. Janus puts the record on the effect path. A step's proposal, the verdict on it and any answer from a validator or a person are durable in a signed, hash-chained log before the step may run or its effect be released; with keys declared, each answer is signed by whoever gave or relayed it. Gates are pure functions of that log, and an auditor re-derives every verdict offline from the log a…
items.why_zh: 它为可调动资金等高风险场景的智能体提供了先验证后执行、可离线审计的溯源机制。
items.why_en: It offers offline-verifiable, evidence-before-effect provenance for agents in high-stakes, money-moving settings.

items.title_zh: Aegis：面向隐私保护医疗联邦学习的生成式梯度掩码
items.title_en: Aegis: Generative Gradient Masking for Privacy-Preserving Medical Federated Learning
items.summary_zh: 联邦学习已成为多机构医疗 AI 的基础范式，让医院与研究中心无需交换患者记录即可联合训练诊断模型。但这一隐私承诺正受到挑战：恶意或“诚实但好奇”的服务器可发起模型反演攻击，直接从共享的模型更新中重建患者私人图像；近期的可扩展闭式攻击在临床现实批量下甚至能穿透安全聚合。针对现有防御的不足，作者提出 Aegis，用生成式梯度掩码来保护隐私。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38339v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has become a foundational paradigm for multi-institutional medical AI, allowing hospitals and research centers to jointly train diagnostic models without exchanging patient records. This privacy promise, however, is increasingly contested: a malicious or honest-but-curious server can launch model inversion attacks (MIAs) that reconstruct private patient images directly from shared model updates, and recent scalable, closed-form attacks penetrate even secure aggregation at clinically realistic batch sizes. Existing defens…
items.why_zh: 若共享更新能被反演还原患者影像，医疗联邦学习的隐私前提将不成立，该防御直面这一现实威胁。
items.why_en: If shared updates can be inverted back into patient images, the privacy premise of medical federated learning collapses, and this work targets that threat directly.

items.title_zh: 面向 RIS 辅助后 5G 网络的 3GPP 兼容基准数据集
items.title_en: A 3GPP-Compliant Benchmark Dataset for RIS-Aided Beyond 5G Networks
items.summary_zh: 可重构智能表面（RIS）正成为后 5G（B5G）网络中可编程无线环境的关键技术，但数据驱动的 RIS 研究长期受制于缺乏标准化、高保真且开源的数据集。作者为此提出一个面向 RIS 辅助毫米波网络的大规模数据集，遵循 3GPP TR 38.901 规范。该数据集特别考虑了严重路径损耗、阻塞敏感性与空间信道稀疏性——这些特性正是 RIS 辅助最能体现价值的场景，可为相关研究提供统一的评测基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39058v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) are emerging as a key technology for programmable wireless environments in the beyond the fifth generation (B5G) networks. However, data-driven RIS research remains bottleneck by the lack of standardized, high-fidelity and open-source datasets. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale 3GPP TR 38.901-compliant dataset for RIS-aided millimeter wave (mmWave) networks, that considers severe path loss, blockage sensitivity, and spatial channel sparsity make the RIS assistance more impactful. The dataset spa…
items.why_zh: 标准化开源数据集能消除 RIS 研究中结果难以比较、难以复现的瓶颈。
items.why_en: A standardized open dataset removes a key barrier to comparable, reproducible RIS research.

items.title_zh: 真实代码仓库中可信的运行时错误修复：基准与护栏
items.title_en: Trustworthy Runtime Error Healing in Real-World Repositories: A Benchmark and Guardrail
items.summary_zh: 运行时错误修复让崩溃的程序通过生成修复代码继续运行。已有研究表明 LLM 能生成这类修复代码，但评测仅限于小型竞赛程序，且在活跃进程中执行 LLM 生成代码带来的安全疑虑尚未得到解决。为把基于 LLM 的运行时修复推向真实仓库的实用场景，作者构建了 HealBench：一个包含来自 18 个真实代码仓库的 265 个运行时错误、每个错误都配有参考修复的基准，并提出相应的护栏机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39086v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Runtime error healing lets a crashed program continue by generating code that repairs its live runtime state. Recent work shows that LLMs can generate such healing code, but it is evaluated only on small competition programs, and executing LLM-generated code inside a live process raises safety concerns that remain unaddressed. In this paper, we take LLM-based runtime healing toward practical use in real-world repositories. We first build HealBench, a benchmark of 265 runtime errors from 18 real-world repositories, each paired with a reference e…
items.why_zh: 它把运行时自修复从玩具程序推向真实仓库，并首次系统应对在线执行 LLM 生成代码的安全风险。
items.why_en: It moves LLM runtime self-healing toward real repositories and squarely addresses the safety risks of executing generated code in live processes.

items.title_zh: Ready2Blend：从自然语言指令到可组合的对齐提示
items.title_en: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
items.summary_zh: 持续对齐要求 LLM 在不遗忘既有行为的前提下适应新要求。自然语言指令灵活且可组合，但对模型只有间接控制力；后训练适应更强，代价是反复更新参数。作者提出 Ready2Blend，把自然语言的灵活性与已学到的对齐结合起来：AlignFormer 将每条要求映射为一个定长对齐提示，存入模块化的提示库中，而主干模型与既有提示保持冻结。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39365v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain froze…
items.why_zh: 它让新对齐要求以可插拔提示的形式叠加，避免反复训练带来的遗忘与算力开销。
items.why_en: It lets new alignment requirements be layered in as plug-in prompts, avoiding repeated parameter updates and forgetting.

items.title_zh: 从语音到可编辑概念：用概念瓶颈模型探究情绪识别
items.title_en: From Speech to Editable Concepts: Probing Emotion Recognition with Concept Bottleneck Models
items.summary_zh: 语音情绪识别（SER）的任务是为语音片段赋予情绪标签。早期系统依赖声学特征，近期方法多融合语音与文本等多模态信息，但在许多数据集上表现仍然不佳。因此，能同时处理多种输入并遵循指令的 LLM 引起关注，不过直接输入音频带来了可解释性问题。作者借鉴图像分类中为解决类似问题而提出的概念瓶颈模型，探索“可编辑概念”的语音情绪识别路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39453v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is the task of assigning emotion labels to utterances. Early systems relied on acoustic features, whereas recent approaches combine multiple modalities, most commonly speech and text. Still, performance remains poor on many datasets. Large language models (LLMs) have therefore attracted interest for SER, as they can process diverse inputs jointly with instructions. However, direct audio input raises questions of explainability. To address similar questions in image classification, concept bottleneck models were…
items.why_zh: 在 LLM 直接“听”音频难以解释的情况下，概念瓶颈模型为语音情绪识别提供了可读、可编辑的中间表示。
items.why_en: Concept bottlenecks give SER a readable, editable intermediate representation when LLM audio input is hard to interpret.

items.title_zh: WARP：不可见图像水印鲁棒性与抗攻击能力的统一基准
items.title_en: WARP: A Unified Benchmark for Invisible Image Watermarking -- Robustness and Protection Against Attacks
items.summary_zh: 随着新出台的法规与行业实践要求标注 AI 生成内容并确保来源可追溯，数字图像水印变得愈发关键。不可见水印方法的最新进展表明，既有基准实践需要更新，以反映当前的技术水平与评价标准。为此，作者提出 WARP——一个用于评估不可见水印鲁棒性的统一框架与基准，其中整合了 32 项近期的经典相关工作（原文摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.40031v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Digital image watermarking is increasingly critical in media contexts, as emerging regulations and industry practices require marking AI-generated content and ensuring traceable sources to prevent manipulation or misuse. Recent advances in invisible watermarking methods highlight the need to update existing benchmarking practices to reflect current techniques and evaluation criteria. We address this by introducing WARP -- a unified framework and benchmark for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks. WARP incorporates 32 recent classic…
items.why_zh: 在监管要求标注 AI 生成内容的背景下，统一基准有助于判断水印是否真能抵御攻击。
items.why_en: As regulations push for marking AI-generated content, a unified benchmark helps show whether watermarking actually survives attacks.

items.title_zh: 将时间序列基础模型锚定到数字孪生拓扑以做预测性维护
items.title_en: Grounding Time-Series Foundation Models in Digital Twin Topology for Predictive Maintenance
items.summary_zh: 数字孪生越来越多地支撑依赖时间序列数据的下游分析任务，这让时间序列基础模型（TSFM）作为可扩展骨干受到关注。但论文指出，TSFM 主要针对时间上的续写进行预训练，在回归等未见任务上往往表现不佳，而且在数字孪生场景中，尚缺乏与最先进专用模型的系统实证对比。为此作者做了三方面工作：第一，在骨干网络冻结的条件下，用剩余使用寿命（RUL）等任务对五个知名 TSFM 进行基准评测，以厘清其与专用模型的差距；第二，探讨把数字孪生的拓扑结构信息引入模型，使其更贴合设备与系统之间的真实关联；第三，给出相应的建模与分析框架。论文强调，只有把拓扑等结构先验与时间序列基础模型结合，才可能在预测性维护中发挥其规模化优势。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.40071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Digital twins increasingly support downstream analytical tasks that depend on time-series data, motivating interest in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as scalable backbones. However, TSFMs are primarily pretrained for temporal continuation and often underperform on unseen tasks such as regression, and systematic empirical comparisons against state-of-the-art dedicated models in digital twin contexts remain limited. This paper makes three contributions. First, we benchmark five well-known TSFMs with frozen backbones on remaining useful lif…
items.why_zh: 指出通用时间序列基础模型在数字孪生预测性维护中仍有明显短板，并给出一条引入拓扑结构先验的改进路径。
items.why_en: It shows where general time-series foundation models fall short in digital twin predictive maintenance and proposes topology grounding as a fix.

items.title_zh: 空间填充曲线就够了：让通信避免型矩阵乘法变简单
items.title_en: Space Filling Curves is All You Need: Communication-Avoiding Matrix Multiplication Made Simple
items.summary_zh: 通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）是高性能计算与深度学习的基石。最先进的厂商库会调优张量布局、并行方案与缓存分块，以尽量减少数据在存储层级间的搬移并最大化吞吐量，但这些参数的最优取值既取决于目标平台，也取决于矩阵形状，穷举调优实际上不可行。本文用空间填充曲线（SFC）来替代这套繁琐的调度搜索与调优：作者按 SFC 对矩阵乘法进行划分，从而以简单统一的规则获得具备通信避免特性的算法，而不必针对每种平台和形状反复搜索参数。这一思路有望把 GEMM 的性能工程从“重度调参”转向“结构化构造”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.16294v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) is the cornerstone of HPC workloads and Deep Learning. State-of-the-art (SOTA) vendor libraries tune tensor layouts, parallelization schemes and cache blocking to minimize data movement across the memory hierarchy and maximize throughput. However, optimal settings for these parameters depend on the target platform and matrix shapes, making exhaustive tuning infeasible. In this work, we address this cumbersome scheduling search and tuning using space-filling curves (SFC). We partition the matrix multi…
items.why_zh: 用统一的空间填充曲线划分取代平台相关的繁琐调参，为高效矩阵乘法提供更简单可移植的做法。
items.why_en: It replaces platform-specific tuning with a uniform space-filling-curve partition, offering a simpler and more portable route to efficient matrix multiplication.

items.title_zh: 广义特征空间中的基础模型保持型优化
items.title_en: Foundation-Preserving Optimization in Generalized Eigenspace
items.summary_zh: 微调能让基础模型适配专门的下游任务，但也会削弱其在预训练阶段获得的非目标任务能力。现有的遗忘感知方法通常借助特殊初始化或固定约束来寻求更安全的更新，却未能在训练过程中主动调节“适配”与“保持”之间的权衡。作者提出 Foundation Preserving LoRA（FoLoRA），一个遗忘感知的优化框架：它在一阶保持条件的指导下，针对预训练参数定义遗忘惩罚项，并在广义特征空间中求解，从而在训练全程约束更新方向，而非只在初始化阶段做一次性处理。该工作为持续微调中同时兼顾新任务性能与原有能力提供了一种训练期机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.00132v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: While finetuning effectively adapts foundation models to specialized downstream tasks, it can degrade nontarget capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing forgetting aware methods typically seek safer updates through specialized initialization or fixed constraints, but do not regulate the adaptation preservation trade-off during training. We propose Foundation Preserving LoRA (FoLoRA), a forgetting aware optimization framework. Guided by a first order preservation condition, FoLoRA defines a forgetting penalty over pretraining-p…
items.why_zh: 把“保持预训练能力”从静态约束变成训练期可控的优化目标，缓解持续微调中的能力遗忘。
items.why_en: It turns capability preservation from a static constraint into a training-time objective, mitigating forgetting during continual fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: RamanPFN：用表格基础模型学习拉曼光谱结构
items.title_en: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
items.summary_zh: 拉曼光谱可在材料科学、分析化学、生物医学与工业过程监测中实现无标记的分子表征，但面向高维光谱的机器学习仍受两重制约：一是带标注数据有限，二是光谱的物理组织方式与“特征无关”的通用模型之间存在错配——仅仅让模型覆盖全部通道，并不能保证物理上相关的谱带共享同一推理上下文。为此作者提出 RamanPFN，一个通用光谱基础框架，用于统一处理不同来源的拉曼光谱任务。其核心思路是让模型在推理时尊重光谱的通道结构，使相关谱带落入共同的上下文，从而在标注稀缺的条件下更好地利用光谱本身的物理规律。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.02157v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Raman spectroscopy enables label-free molecular characterization across materials science, analytical chemistry, biomedicine, and industrial process monitoring. However, machine learning for high-dimensional spectroscopy remains constrained by limited labelled data and a mismatch between the physical organization of spectra and feature-agnostic models. Channel coverage alone does not ensure that related bands share a common inference context. Here we present RamanPFN, a general-purpose spectral foundation framework that enables unified…
items.why_zh: 提出让基础模型尊重光谱物理结构而非仅做通道覆盖，为标注稀缺的光谱分析提供通用框架。
items.why_en: It argues foundation models must respect spectral structure rather than mere channel coverage, offering a general framework for label-scarce spectroscopy.

items.title_zh: AI 聊天机器人能找到专家会找的研究吗？模型、用户角色与样本量对医学问题文献检索的影响
items.title_en: Do AI chatbots find what experts would? Effects of model, user role, and sample size on study retrieval for medical questions
items.summary_zh: LLM 聊天机器人越来越多被用来回答临床问题并附上相关研究引用，但所检索证据的质量以及影响文献选择的因素仍不清楚。作者用改编自 2026 年 Cochrane 综述的 20 个临床问题，评估了三个通用 LLM 聊天机器人：Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 ChatGPT GPT-5.5。实验模拟患者、临床医生与证据综合研究者三种用户角色，并针对每个“聊天机器人—角色—问题”组合各获取四次独立回答，以考察模型、用户角色与样本量对研究检索结果的影响。该研究关注的不是回答是否流畅，而是机器人找到的文献是否与专家会选出的证据一致，从而为临床场景中使用带引用的 LLM 提供实证参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13786v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used to answer clinical questions with citations to relevant studies, yet the quality of retrieved evidence and factors influencing study selection remain unclear. We evaluated three general-purpose LLM chatbots (Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and ChatGPT GPT-5.5) using 20 clinical questions adapted from 2026 Cochrane reviews. We simulated patient, clinician, and evidence-synthesis researcher roles and obtained four independent responses for each chatbot-role-question combination, y…
items.why_zh: 临床场景已开始依赖带引用的 LLM 检索证据，其检索质量与偏差来源直接关系医疗决策的可信度。
items.why_en: Clinical use of citation-generating LLM chatbots makes retrieval quality and its biases directly relevant to the trustworthiness of medical decisions.

items.title_zh: DAMP：衰减感知的混合精度循环状态量化
items.title_en: DAMP: Decay-Aware Mixed-Precision Recurrent-State Quantization
items.summary_zh: 复杂推理与智能体应用日益依赖长上下文推理，不断增长的 KV 缓存同时推高了显存占用与解码开销。混合模型通过把 Softmax Attention 与 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）或 Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）结合，用固定大小的循环状态来降低这些成本。这些状态通常以 FP32 存储，占用大量 GPU 显存，而其更新又受内存带宽限制。量化可以同时减少存储占用与内存流量，但作者发现统一量化并非最优：状态的各个部分在衰减特性上并不相同，对更新影响更大的分量应保留更高精度。DAMP 因此提出按衰减特性分配混合精度的量化方案，在压缩循环状态的同时尽量保住模型质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27513v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Complex reasoning and agentic applications increasingly rely on long-context inference, where growing KV caches increase both memory usage and decoding overhead. Hybrid models reduce these costs by combining Softmax Attention with Gated DeltaNet (GDN) or Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), which maintain fixed-size recurrent states. These states are commonly stored in FP32 and consume substantial GPU memory, while their updates are limited by memory bandwidth. Quantization can reduce both storage footprint and memory traffic, but we find that u…
items.why_zh: 针对长上下文推理的显存与带宽瓶颈，给出依据衰减特性分配精度的循环状态量化方案。
items.why_en: It targets the memory and bandwidth bottleneck of long-context inference by quantizing recurrent states according to their decay behavior.

items.title_zh: LeanPolish：面向 Lean 证明压缩的可验证监督
items.title_en: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
items.summary_zh: 经过验证的证明编辑是提升语言模型生成 Lean 证明能力的天然监督来源，但验证只能保证编辑本身正确，并不能保证其训练信号里不含搜索过程的伪影。作者提出 LeanPolish，一个符号化的 Lean 4 流水线，发布了 33,402 条被接受的局部编辑和 65,596 条处于相同状态的失败尝试，并据此研究模型究竟能从这类监督中学到什么。研究发现，首次成功（first-success）搜索会引入一条与目标无关、却拥有完美排序准确率的规则；由教师选定的评估位置也会奖励琐碎或表面的编辑。这提示：可验证的监督若不经筛选，可能把搜索噪声和“无用但可验证”的编辑一并教给模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivia…
items.why_zh: 警示可验证证明编辑作为监督信号时可能夹带搜索伪影与琐碎编辑，为构建训练数据提供了筛选依据。
items.why_en: It warns that verified proof edits can carry search artifacts and trivia, informing how such supervision data should be filtered.

items.title_zh: 量化循环状态缓存中的低差异抖动
items.title_en: Low-Discrepancy Dither for Quantized Recurrent State Caches
items.summary_zh: Mamba 类与混合语言模型把历史压缩成一个固定大小的循环状态，并在每生成一个 token 时重写它。以低精度存储该状态可以节省内存带宽，但每一次舍入误差都会被反馈进下一次更新，在长文本生成中可能不断累积。生产系统通常采用随机舍入，本文则追问这类缓存究竟应该使用哪种舍入规则。作者发现，一种无需任何随机数的确定性黄金比例 Weyl 抖动，能够持续让量化后的模型更接近全精度模型，相当于用低成本的低差异序列替代随机抖动，从而在长生成过程中更稳定地抑制误差累积。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mamba-style and hybrid language models compress their past into a fixed-size recurrent state that is rewritten at every generated token. Storing this state in low precision saves memory bandwidth, but every rounding error is fed back into the next update and can accumulate over long generations. Production systems round the state stochastically; we ask which rounding rule such caches should use. We find that a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither, which needs no random numbers, consistently brings the quantized model closer to the full-precisio…
items.why_zh: 用无需随机数的确定性抖动规则缓解量化循环状态在长生成中的误差累积，兼顾省显存与输出稳定性。
items.why_en: A deterministic, random-number-free dither rule curbs error accumulation in quantized recurrent states, pairing memory savings with stability over long generations.

items.title_zh: 面向开放权重 LLM 的基于网络的空间上下文检索：地理推理忠实度基准
items.title_en: Network-based Spatial Context Retrieval for Open-weight LLMs: A Faithfulness Benchmark for Grounded Geographic Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 这项研究关注大语言模型在地理空间推理上的短板：模型虽蕴含大量潜在地理知识，但仅凭坐标提问时推理表现很差，只有在提示中补充结构化空间上下文后才表现出有用行为。作者提出一套基于网络检索空间上下文、并面向开放权重模型的开放流水线，同时构建“忠实度”基准，检验一个此前评测未涉及的问题——当正确的上下文已被提供时，模型究竟是依据上下文进行推理，还是用自身参数化记忆覆盖它。该工作为地理空间评测补上了“是否忠实于给定证据”这一关键维度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode substantial latent geographic knowledge, yet they reason poorly over space and are unreliable when queried from coordinates alone. Useful behaviour emerges only when structured spatial context is supplied in the prompt. This raises a question geographic evaluation has left unexamined: once the right context is supplied, does the model reason from it, or override it with its own parametric recall? We take up this question with an open pipeline for network-based spatial context retriev-al. In it, the surroundings…
items.why_zh: 它把地理评测的焦点从“模型知道什么”转向“模型是否忠实使用给定上下文”，直接关系到地理空间应用的可靠性。
items.why_en: It shifts geographic evaluation from what a model knows to whether it faithfully uses supplied context, which is central to reliable geospatial applications.

items.title_zh: 在不完美先验下学习可靠的 GUI 智能体
items.title_en: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型和视觉语言模型的 GUI 智能体在未见过的应用和复杂多步任务上仍表现不佳，原因是真实 GUI 任务依赖特定应用、随时间易变的操作知识，而这类知识在预训练语料中十分稀缺。检索增强执行是自然的补救办法，但存在两个相互耦合的瓶颈：大规模知识难以获取；自采集的先验会因版本更新、推广活动、广告、A/B 测试和个性化而不可避免地偏离线上真实环境。论文据此论证需要新的方法来应对这种先验漂移问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: GUI agents built on large language and vision-language models still struggle on unseen applications and complex multi-step tasks, as completing real GUI tasks depends on app-specific, temporally volatile operational knowledge that is scarce in pretraining corpora. Retrieval-augmented execution offers a natural remedy but faces two coupled bottlenecks: knowledge at scale is hard to acquire, and self-collected priors inevitably drift from the live environment due to version updates, promotions, ads, A/B tests, and personalization. We therefore argu…
items.why_zh: GUI 智能体的落地瓶颈不只在模型能力，更在于知识获取与环境漂移，这为构建可持续使用的智能体指明了关键方向。
items.why_en: The real bottleneck for GUI agents lies in knowledge acquisition and environment drift, not just model capability, shaping how durable agents must be built.

items.title_zh: 超越均匀压缩：极端联邦学习中的预算化传输分配
items.title_en: Beyond Uniform Compression: Budgeted Transmission Allocation for Extreme Federated Learning
items.summary_zh: 联邦学习在客户端上传高维模型更新时面临严重的通信瓶颈，现有方法通常对所有层做均匀压缩，忽略了不同参数块的异质价值，把有限带宽浪费在不敏感的层上。为此作者提出逐层预算自适应传输方法 LBAT，把极端上行带宽约束下的联邦通信重新表述为一个资源分配问题，并动态估计各层的传输价值，从而在给定预算下更高效地分配通信资源。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning faces severe communication bottlenecks when clients upload high-dimensional model updates. Existing methods often compress these updates uniformly across all layers. This uniform approach ignores the heterogeneous value of different parameter blocks and wastes limited bandwidth on insensitive layers. To address this issue, we propose Layer-wise Budgeted Adaptive Transmission (LBAT). LBAT reframes federated communication under extreme uplink budgets as a resource allocation problem. Our framework dynamically estimates the transm…
items.why_zh: 在极端带宽受限场景下，把通信视为层间资源分配问题可显著提升联邦学习的效率，而非一刀切压缩。
items.why_en: Treating communication as a layer-wise allocation problem under extreme bandwidth limits can substantially improve federated learning efficiency over one-size-fits-all compression.

items.title_zh: Nixtlaverse：面向时间序列预测的开源生态
items.title_en: The Nixtlaverse: An Open-Source Ecosystem for Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 大型预测应用往往同时结合统计模型、机器学习和神经网络模型。这些模型族解决的是同一问题，但在拟合状态、训练流程以及并行化方式上各不相同，导致预测软件要么把这些差异隐藏在单一估计器接口之后，要么将不同模型族分置于各自独立的包中，迫使用户为每个包重写数据准备与评估代码。论文以 Nixtlaverse 为例，介绍这一面向时间序列预测的开源 Python 库生态系统，展示它如何应对上述割裂问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large forecasting applications often combine statistical, machine-learning, and neural models. These families solve the same problem but differ in fitted state, training procedures, and how they parallelize work. Forecasting software must therefore either hide these differences behind a single estimator interface, or keep the families in separate packages, forcing users to rewrite data preparation and evaluation for every package. We present the Nixtlaverse, an ecosystem of open-source Python libraries for time series forecasting, as a case study…
items.why_zh: 统一的开源预测生态可减少跨模型族重复工程，让统计、机器学习与神经预测方法更易于组合使用。
items.why_en: A unified open-source forecasting ecosystem cuts duplicated engineering and makes it easier to combine statistical, ML and neural forecasters.

items.title_zh: 通过梯度封sealing实现抵御禁用能力获取的预先式 LLM 遗忘
items.title_en: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing
items.summary_zh: 开放权重大模型不仅是固定产品，也是下游微调的基础材料，这种开放性带来法律与伦理风险：用户可能通过微调注入非法知识或支撑敌对行为。因此模型提供方需要在发布前具备防御手段，论文由此提出“预先式遗忘”问题。与针对固定模型中已有能力进行移除的回顾式遗忘不同，预先式遗忘旨在防止模型在未见过的微调攻击下获得这些能力，作者给出的方法是梯度封sealing。该工作面向模型发布前的合规防御需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-weight LLMs are released not only as fixed products but also as substrates for downstream fine-tuning. This openness, however, creates legal and ethical risks because users may misuse fine-tuning to instill illicit knowledge or enable hostile operations. Model providers therefore need apre-release defense against such acquisition, motivating the problem of preemptive unlearning. Unlike retrospective unlearning, which removes capabilities already present in a fixed model, preemptive unlearning seeks to prevent their acquisition under unseen a…
items.why_zh: 它为开源模型提供了一种发布前的防护思路，把安全防线从“发布后补救”前移到“能力获取之前”。
items.why_en: It offers a pre-release defense for open-weight models, moving safety from post-hoc remediation to blocking capability acquisition before it happens.

items.title_zh: 个性化 AI 中的隐私是系统属性，而不仅是模型属性
items.title_en: Privacy in Personalized AI Is a System Property, Not Just a Model Property
items.summary_zh: 在对话助手、推荐系统等个性化 AI 应用中，用户面对的不是孤立的模型，而是会在多个组件之间、跨时间访问、推断并复用用户信息的更大系统。这种对用户信息的使用是个性化的核心，同时也带来重要隐私问题。论文论证，仅做单个模型或单个组件层面的分析可能无法捕捉这类系统中的全部隐私风险，因此需要从系统层面看待隐私，并对不同层面的隐私问题加以区分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38289v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In personalized AI applications, such as conversational assistants and recommender systems, users interact not with models in isolation but with broader systems that access, infer, and reuse user information across components and over time. While such use of user information is integral to personalization, it also raises important privacy questions. In this paper, we argue that individual model- or component-level analyses may not capture all privacy risks arising in such systems, motivating a system-level perspective on privacy. We distinguish…
items.why_zh: 把隐私视为系统属性，意味着评估与合规必须覆盖组件间的数据流动与长期复用，而不仅是单个模型。
items.why_en: Framing privacy as a system property means evaluation and compliance must cover cross-component data flows and long-term reuse, not just a single model.

items.title_zh: 公平性剧场：评估厂商掌控的预警系统中的事后公平干预
items.title_en: Fairness Theatre: Evaluating Post-Hoc Fairness Interventions in Vendor-Controlled Early Warning Systems
items.summary_zh: 公共机构越来越多地采购无法检视或修改设计的 AI 系统。在高等教育领域，专有预警系统（EWS）让高校除了调整模型输出来应对不公平之外几乎没有别的选择。论文由此提问：在厂商、院校、顾问与学生之间权力不对等的情况下，公平性工作是如何被协调的？作者使用加拿大安大略一所公立大学的学生记录，在模拟采购条件下对一套研究用预警系统上的六种事后公平干预措施进行了评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38552v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Public institutions increasingly procure AI systems whose design they cannot inspect or change. In higher education, proprietary Early Warning Systems (EWS) leave colleges with few options beyond adjusting model outputs to address inequity. This raises the question of how fairness work is coordinated among vendors, institutions, advisors, and students with unequal power to change these systems? Using student records from a public college in Ontario, Canada, we evaluate six post-hoc fairness interventions on a research EWS under simulated procur…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了采购制 AI 中“事后调输出”式公平的局限，以及权力不对等下公平治理的结构性问题。
items.why_en: It exposes the limits of post-hoc output adjustments for fairness in procured AI and the structural power imbalances in fairness governance.

items.title_zh: PrivCert：在差分隐私下证明陈述的支持度
items.title_en: PrivCert: Certifying Statement Support under Differential Privacy
items.summary_zh: 差分隐私文本生成可以保护个体记录，但仅有隐私并不说明所发布的陈述对底层数据具有怎样的证据支持。作者将这一问题称为“证据缺口”：一份私密报告可能包含看似合理的断言，却没有说明它们是否得到私有数据集的有力支撑。为此论文提出 PrivCert 框架，通过隐私保护证书以及“发布或弃权”的决策机制，让陈述的支持度变得明确，并给出了一个典型的实例化方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38934v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Differentially private (DP) text generation can protect individual records, but privacy alone does not specify what evidence a released statement carries about the underlying data. We identify this as an evidence gap: a private report may contain plausible claims without indicating whether they are strongly supported by the private dataset. We introduce PrivCert, a framework for privacy-preserving reporting that makes statement support explicit through privacy-preserving certificates and emit-or-abstain decisions. As a canonical instantiation,…
items.why_zh: 它把“隐私”与“证据充分性”分开处理，让差分隐私输出不仅安全，还能说明其结论有多少数据支撑。
items.why_en: It separates privacy from evidential support, so differentially private outputs can state how well the data actually backs their claims.

items.title_zh: 面向更高效、稳健、实例自适应且可泛化的序贯决策
items.title_en: Towards More Efficient, Robust, Instance-adaptive, and Generalizable Sequential Decision making
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文（编号 2504.09192v5，替换版本）概述了一项博士研究的总体目标：为不确定性下的数据驱动序贯决策设计可证明高效且实用的算法。研究聚焦强化学习（RL）与多臂老虎机（multi-armed bandits）及其应用，涵盖推荐系统、计算机网络、视频分析与大语言模型（LLM）等方向。作者指出，老虎机与强化学习等序贯决策方法已取得显著成功，例如在 Atari、围棋等复杂游戏中超越人类玩家，并推动机器人技术进步。论文由此探讨如何让这类方法更高效、更稳健、能自适应具体实例并具备泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.09192v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The primary goal of my Ph.D. study is to develop provably efficient and practical algorithms for data-driven sequential decision-making under uncertainty. My work focuses on reinforcement learning (RL), multi-armed bandits, and their applications, including recommendation systems, computer networks, video analytics, and large language models (LLMs). Sequential decision-making methods, such as bandits and RL, have demonstrated remarkable success - ranging from outperforming human players in complex games like Atari and Go to advancing robotics…
items.why_zh: 序贯决策是推荐、网络调度与大模型等系统的核心，提升其效率与泛化性可直接影响大量实际应用。
items.why_en: Sequential decision-making underpins recommenders, network scheduling and LLM systems, so improving its efficiency and generalization has broad practical impact.

items.title_zh: 用于稀疏斜向森林的向量化动态直方图
items.title_en: Vectorized Dynamic Histograms for Sparse Oblique Forests
items.summary_zh: 论文（arXiv:2603.00326v2，替换版本）针对 Google Yggdrasil 决策森林（YDF）中表现最优配置之一——稀疏斜向（SPO）森林的训练方法进行改进。SPO 通过扫描特征的稀疏线性组合而非单一特征，在保持随机森林（RF）与梯度提升树（GBT）可解释性的同时提升准确率。但由于投影在运行时采样，无法使用预排序等预先优化手段，训练明显变慢。作者重构了 YDF 中的 SPO 训练流程，先修复已发布版本中的低效问题，实现了 2-5 倍加速。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.00326v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sparse oblique (SPO), part of the top-ranked configuration of Google's Yggdrasil Decision Forests (YDF), improve the accuracy while maintaining interpretability of Random Forests (RF) and Gradient Boosted Trees (GBT) by scanning a sparse linear combination of features instead of a single feature. Because projections are sampled at runtime, training is significantly slower, as pre-run optimizations such as presorting cannot be used. We overhaul SPO training in YDF, first by fixing inefficiencies in the released version, achieving 2-5x speedup,…
items.why_zh: 加速稀疏斜向森林训练，使这一兼具高准确率与可解释性的决策森林配置更具大规模落地价值。
items.why_en: Speeding up sparse oblique forest training makes a highly accurate yet interpretable decision-forest configuration practical to deploy at scale.

items.why_en: If confirmed, it signals that Chinese open-source models are gaining procurement acceptance among enterprise customers of a leading global AI company, shifting the open-source competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: FTC对Anthropic与OpenAI展开广泛调查
items.title_en: FTC launches broad investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI
items.summary_zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）对 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 展开范围广泛的调查。报道摘要未给出调查的具体事由、涉及条款或时间表等细节。两家头部 AI 公司同时被纳入调查，显示美国监管机构对生成式 AI 领域的关注持续升温。
items.summary_en: FTC launches broad investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI The Washington Post
items.why_zh: FTC 同时调查两家头部 AI 公司，可能影响其合规与业务布局，也预示美国对生成式 AI 的监管进一步收紧。
items.why_en: The FTC's scrutiny of both leading AI firms could affect their compliance and business plans, and signals tightening U.S. regulation of generative AI.

items.title_zh: 马斯克的Grokipedia迎来v0.3更新，设计“焕然一新”
items.title_en: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
items.summary_zh: 马斯克旗下的 Grokipedia 迎来 v0.3 更新，被 SpaceXAI 设计负责人 Benji Taylor 称为“焕然一新”的版本。Grokipedia 是 SpaceXAI 推出的 AI 驱动维基百科竞品，近期已重新开始接受用户编辑。此次更新包括新 logo，并改版了首页与实时编辑页面：旧首页基本只有 logo 和搜索框，新首页加入了精选条目列表、最多阅读条目列表，以及展示“最新编辑”的追踪器，精选列表中还用数字化的书籍形象进行展示。
items.summary_en: Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again , and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page. SpaceXAI head of design Benji Taylor calls it a "newly refreshed Grokipedia." Grokipedia's old homepage was pretty much just a logo and a search bar, but the updated homepage includes a list of featured articles, a list of the most-read articles, and a tracker showing the "latest edits." The new featured list showcases digital representations of books that yo…
items.why_zh: Grokipedia 在恢复用户编辑后继续迭代改版，显示马斯克阵营仍在加码 AI 生成百科这一敏感的信息入口。
items.why_en: Grokipedia's continued redesign after resuming user edits shows Musk's camp is still investing in an AI-generated encyclopedia, a sensitive information gateway.

items.summary_en: Sohu reports that Zhipu is giving away over 100 million tokens to developers, prompting debate over whether the move can rebuild developer trust. The report frames the question around Zhipu's standing in the developer ecosystem. Details on eligibility, allocation and developer reaction are not provided.

items.why_en: The developer ecosystem is key to competition among LLM vendors, and Zhipu's large token giveaway is seen as an attempt to repair developer relations.

items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Components in Huawei Tie-Up to Reduce Nvidia Reliance

items.why_en: A leading model developer publicly backing domestic chips is a significant step toward reducing reliance on Nvidia and building China's own AI compute stack.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced Huawei Ascend base components, with Huawei offering unreserved support. The collaboration links DeepSeek's software stack with Ascend hardware in a bid to cut reliance on Nvidia.

items.why_en: The tie-up between a top model maker and a domestic chip platform could shape how self-sufficient China's AI compute supply chain becomes.

items.title_en: 'A Trillion Gone in Three Months': Media Ask What Happened to Zhipu
items.summary_zh: 三个月蒸发一万亿！智谱到底怎么了？ 财富号
items.summary_en: A Sina Finance article asks what has happened to Chinese AI model developer Zhipu, citing a "one trillion" wipeout over three months. The abstract offers no further detail on what the figure refers to, making the claim hard to verify.
items.why_zh: 智谱是国产大模型头部公司，其估值与经营动向被视为行业景气度的重要信号。
items.why_en: Zhipu is one of China's leading LLM startups, so questions about its fortunes are read as a signal for the broader sector.
